server_name.description: Public name of the server shown in server browsers.

master_server.description: Master server for listing the server publicly. Use '0' to disable public listing.

port.description: UDP port the server listens on.

game_type.description: Game mode: 0=Free For All, 1=Tourney, 2=Team Deathmatch, 3=Capture the Flag, 4=1v1, 5=Arms Race.

time_limit.description: Match time limit in minutes. Set to 0 for unlimited.

frag_limit.description: Frag limit to end match. Set to 0 for unlimited.

allow_vote.description: Allow players to vote on map changes, settings, etc.

allow_chat.description: Allow in-game player chat (team chat still works if disabled).

enable_custom_models.description: Allow players to use custom player models and skins.

map_list.description: Ordered list of maps allowed in map rotations. First map is default.

server_description.default: Fast-paced OpenArena server with classic gameplay.
server_description.description: Short description of your server for the browser.

password.description: Password required to join. Leave empty for no password.

log_file.description: Log file path or numeric log level alias: 0=none, 1=errors, 2=normal, 3=verbose. Use '2' for default log output.

log_level.description: Verbosity of server logging. Higher = more detailed logs.

dedicated.description: Run as a dedicated server (true) or listen server (false).

min_ping.description: Minimum acceptable ping (ms). Lower than this is considered a fake ping.

max_ping.description: Maximum acceptable ping (ms). Players above this may be kicked.

allow_spectators.description: Allow players to join as spectators.

spectator_password.description: Password for spectators. Leave empty if no spectator password.

team_balance.description: Enable automatic team balancing for team-based game modes.

no_chat_bots.description: Prevent bots from chatting (recommended for performance).

allow_bots.description: Allow bots to join the server.

bot_count.description: Number of bots to spawn. Only active if allow_bots is true.

custom_settings.description: Additional key-value settings (e.g., 'g_motd' for message of the day).
